scope: Every R-column indexed M328-bearing line on PDF585–587, printed574–576; all three pages remain M328 block. Context lines are excluded.

protocol.selection: Exhaustive within assigned three printed pages; no corpus-export completion or semantic selection
protocol.normalization: Reverse literal visual order to primary normalized RTL sequence; actual object writing direction unasserted
protocol.asterisk: Source doubt attaches to following M code in tokens; not loss or additional-sign marker
protocol.LOSS: One positive but unspecified damaged span; never substitute for reviewer inability to identify visible glyph
protocol.UNKNOWN: Visible glyph whose M identity the reviewer cannot authenticate; distinct from primary loss
protocol.indexed_position: Zero-based position of the M328 aligned under R, preserving multiple sightings if present
protocol.deduplication: No cross-source deduplication performed; side/line retained explicitly for parent join
